---
name: "Submit scientific evidence"
about: "Suggest a study, guideline, data source, or original research for independent review."
title: "[EVIDENCE] "
---

Thank you for helping improve the scientific basis of Ancestry Health. Researchers, clinicians, students, patients, and interested readers are welcome; professional credentials are **not required**. It is fine to answer "unknown" where appropriate.

**Area of research:** (body-weight/anthropometry, ancestry and population health, nutrition, laboratory biomarkers, hereditary conditions, pharmacogenetics, or other)

**What claim or question does this research address?**

**Source(s):** (authors, title, publication year, DOI/PMID or stable public link; distinguish peer-reviewed publication, guideline, preprint, or unpublished work; note corrections, retractions, or newer versions if known)

**Study context:** (study design, participant population and recruitment setting, sample size, comparison, main measured outcome, follow-up)

**Key result and uncertainty:** (effect estimate and confidence interval or another appropriate measure, if available; distinguish correlation from causation)

**Limitations or conflicting evidence:** (including underrepresented groups and limits to applicability)

**What should the project consider changing?** (documentation, citation, public explanation, hypothesis to investigate, or new feature; no automatic clinical integration)

**Relevant existing Ancestry Health page, claim ID or issue:** (if known)

**Your connection to the work and potential conflicts of interest:** (optional affiliation/role; please disclose funding, authorship, patents, product interests, or other material conflicts; you need not provide private contact information)

**Copyright and privacy:** Link to third-party articles instead of posting full text or restricted figures. If offering original text/data for inclusion, confirm you have the right to share and license it under the repository's applicable terms. Do not include identifiable health records, genotypes, or patient data.

Submissions are public, may be discussed or corrected, and are not endorsements or evidence of clinical validation. See [scientific review process](../../docs/SCIENTIFIC_CONTRIBUTIONS.md).
